column1: # AetherOS looks: one line = a complete appearance, applied with `aether-look apply NAME`
# palette: "wallpaper" = colours from your wallpaper; anything else is an aether-colors preset.

column11: Anime Dream — soft glass capsules, dusk gradients, film-title lock screen
Cyberpunk Neon — glowing black bar, square segments, neon lock screen
Glass — frosted capsules, icon-grid launcher, frosted lock panel
Emerald — teal blocks, side launcher, large typography lock
Retro Wave — two bars in purple and pink, stacked pastel lock clock
Developer Pro — dense meters and network speed, minimal lock
Lofi — thin dark bar, centred date, quiet icons
Frost — frosted grey capsules, icon-grid launcher
Desk — menu bar on top, dock with open windows at the bottom
Orbit — no bar, floating workspace pill, mini dock
Retro — one line of coloured readings with separators
Pixel — compact icon strip, fastfetch on Super+F12
Blocks — square accent blocks, boxed workspaces
Home — thin top bar, expanding island (now playing), macOS-style dock with Launchpad
Mono — black and white outlined panels, tiled terminals and a big clock
